name: Qwen3.5-0.8B model card
notes: Hugging Face model card and config.json for Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B, read 2026-11-08. Used for two things: the card benchmark table (columns Qwen3-4B-2507 / Qwen3-1.7B / Qwen3.5-2B / Qwen3.5-0.8B, split into Non-Thinking, Knowledge & STEM (Thinking), Instruction Following, Long Context, Reasoning, General Agent, Multilingualism blocks), and config.json for the architecture block of models/qwen3-5-0-8b - 24 layers, 6 full_attention + 18 linear_attention, hidden 1024, 8 query / 2 KV heads, head_dim 256, max_position_embeddings 262144, vocab 248320, tie_word_embeddings true. NOTE: this is the POST-TRAINED repo. The pre-trained Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base is a different repo and is the base cited by models/xiaomi-ocr-0; the two should not be conflated, and this record does not describe the Base checkpoint.
